name: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited
summary: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in vehicle financing business in India. The company operates through Financing Activities and Other Reconciling Items segments. It offers financing for new and pre-owned auto, utility vehicles, tractors, passenger cars, and commercial vehicles; and vehicle leasing solutions through its digital platform Quiklyz to fleet operators, farmers, businesses, self-employed, and salaried individuals.
